beliefs: f strips trailing spaces from the input [E2, E8, E16, E21]

The strip applies to 'Hb','Hc','Ha','Hx' (length 2) as well as longer 'Hbc','Hbcx' etc. [E21]
The strip applies regardless of what follows the second lowercase char (spaces, digits, symbols, more letters) [E6, E11, E12]
